note: Private RV park at I-75 Exit 56 in Niota, about halfway between Chattanooga and Knoxville; takes monthly residents as well as overnight guests. Grassy tent area by the restrooms (no tents in winter, one-week tent maximum). Owners live on site. --Claude
summary: Tennessee Country confirmed on its own site: 22 full-hookup sites (20/30/50 A), $40 a night tax included (stored confirmed), $240 weekly, $450 monthly residents; year-round, phone booking, showers/laundry/wifi. Google 4.2 (119). Nightly share unmeasured.
flags: LONG-STAY: the park sells nightly ($40), weekly and monthly ($450 + metered electric) and says it is open 'for overnight guests as well as short term and long term guests'. The nightly share of its 22 sites is not stated anywhere and was not measured (no booking engine). Google Maps 4.2 stars / 119 reviews. A posted nightly rate and an ordinary transient description: kept as nightly in character, reviewer may want the share.
SITES: count 22 from the operator's site plan (stored note said '~22-50 sites').
